source_text: Proponents of the term 'female genital mutilation', including human rights groups and medical bodies, maintain it precisely conveys the procedure's causality in lifelong physical and psychological sequelae—evidenced by studies showing up to 30% complication rates in acute phases—distinguishing it from male circumcision's purported benefits like reduced HIV transmission (supported by randomized trials in Africa). [11]
